tei:div.tei:p: "$ (101)༄༅/ 'phags yul gyi grub chen brgyad cu rtsa bzhi la mchod cing gsol ba gdab pa'i cho ga dngos grub kun 'byung zhes bya ba bzhugs so//

(102)༄༅// na mo gu ru yo ge shwa rā ya/ bla med sngags kyi lam las sgra ji bzhin// sku tshe gcig gis mi slob zung 'jug brnyes// grub mchog rnam 'byor pho mo'i zhabs pad la// gus pas 'dud do bdag rgyud byin gyis rlobs// mtshan tsam gyis kyang don chen mdzad gyur na// mchod cing gus gsol btab na srid dang zhi'i// 'ching sgrol grub gnyis 'bad med stsol ba la// yid gnyis spangs pas de don gsal bar brjod// slob dpon dpa' bo 'od gsal lugs kyi grub chen brgyad cu rtsa bzhi la mchod cing gsol ba gdab ste tshogs gsog rgyas par bya ba'i tshul bla ma mchod pa spyi mthun gyi sa bcad rje btsun tā ra nā thas gnang ba ltar nyams su len pa la gsum/ sbyor ba yo byad kyi gshom/ dngos gzhi tshogs gsog gi rim pa/ rjes byin rlabs zhu bstims sogs so// dang po ni/ dben zhing yid du 'ong pa'i gnas khang byi dor byas shing bla bre rgyan gyi yod byad gang 'dzoms ltar/ gung du grub brgya'i bris skus mtshon pa'i rten bkram/ de mdun stegs bu khebs ldan gyi dbus su mañdzi'am maṇ+ḍal 'jog pa'i stegs mtho bar bkod/ mdun du chu gnyis dang*/ 'byor bas lcogs na me tog /spos/ mar me/ dri (103)chab/ zhal zas rnams re re brgya rtsa sogs bskor te bsham/ ma 'byor na tshar gsum mam gcig phreng tshar du bkod/ gzugs sgra dri ro reg bya/ bkra shis rdzas rtags/ rgyal srid sna bdun/ rig ma bcu drug la sogs pa mchod pa'i rdzas gang 'byor gzugs sam ri mor bris pa 'dzom na bsham/ ma 'dzom na dmigs pas 'thus/ nang mchod thod pa'i bdud rtsi/ tshogs kyi yod byad ci ltar 'byor pa rnams 'du bya/ rang gi mdun du rin po che'i maṇ+ḍal che legs/ tshom bu'i rgyu 'bru gtsang dag /dung zhal chu gtsang blugs pa dang*/ ba byung dri bzang gi chu sbyar ba gnyis rnams dang*/ mchod pa'i maṇ+ḍal/ rdor dril dang rol mo'i rigs kyang nye bar bsdog go

/gnyis pa la thog mar rang nyid thun mtshams lha'i nga rgyal dang ldan pa'i gnas dang yod byad byin brlabs pa ni/ oṃ badz+ra a mṛ ta kuṇ+ḍa lī ha na ha na hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ swa bhā wa shud+dhaḥsarba dharmāḥswabhā wa shud+dho ྅ haṃ/ gis bsang sbyang/ stong pa'i ngang las gnas khang bh+rūm̐ las rin po che las grub pa'i gzhal med khang brtsegs mtshan nyid thams cad yongs su rdzogs pa'i dbus su/ oṃ las byung ba'i rin po che las grub pa'i snod yangs (104)shing rgya che ba rnams kyi nang du/ hūm̐ zhu ba las byung ba'i lha rdzas las grub pa'i mchod yon/ zhabs bsil/ me tog /bdugs spos/ snang gsal/ zhal zas/ rol mo la sogs mchod rdzas bzang zhing dge bas nam mkha'i khams thams cad gang bar gyur/ oṃ badz+ra ar+ghaṃ swā hā/ oṃ badz+ra pā t+yaṃ swā hā/ oṃ badz+ra puṣ+pe āḥhūm̐/ oṃ badz+ra dhū pe āḥhūm̐/ ā lo ke/ gan+dhe/ nai wid+ye/ shab+da āḥhūm̐/ zhes rol mos byin dpa'/ skyabs 'gro sems bskyed tshig rgyas bsdus gang rung spyi mthun nam bsdu na/ sangs rgyas chos tshogs lan gsum bya/ sems can thams cad bde ba dang sogs kyis tshad med bzhi bsgom/ skad cig gis bla ma rdo rje 'chang grub thob pho mo'i tshogs dang bcas pa mdun gyi nam mkhar bzhugs par gyur/ chu byin rlabs ni/ oṃ badz+ra u da ke hūm̐ swā hā/ dung chos blangs/ oṃ hrīḥswā hā/ kha bshal la/ oṃ waṃ swā hā/ mgo dang gdong bkru zhing*/ ji ltar bltams pa sogs/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta ā bhi ṣe ka ta sa ma ya shrī ye hūm̐/ gnas gsum du reg la/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ gdan la me tog bzhag cing*/ oṃ tiṣ+ṭha badz+ra ā sa na hūm̐/ oṃ badz+ra ba ba na ba na ya swā hā/ me tog rna ltag tu gzer la/ oṃ badz+ra a mṛ ta kuṇ+ḍa li rak+ṣa māṃ/ sarba bighān bh+yaḥ dri bzang chas byin rlabs ni/ oṃ badz+ra u da ke hūm̐ swā hā/ me tog byin rlabs ni/ oṃ na mo bha ga wa te puṣ+pe ke tu rā dzā ya ta thā ga tā ya/

ar+ha te sa mya ka sa mūd+dhā ya/ tad+yathā/ oṃ puṣ+pe puṣ+pe ma hā puṣ+pe/ su pu ṣ+pe puṣ+pe saṃ bha we puṣ+po ta bha we puṣ+pa girne swā hā/ lan gsum mam bdun brjod/ ba byung sogs byin rlabs ni/ oṃ go ye swā hā/ bgegs sbyang ba ni/ oṃ badz+ra sa twa bi ghā nu sā ra ya hūm̐ phaṭa/ maṇ+ḍal re kha bri/ oṃ badz+ra re khā+e swā hā/ ba lci chur bcas sbyin pa ste/ byi dor byas pa tshul khrims yin// grogs sbur bsal ba bzod pa ste// brtson 'grus bya ba byed la brtson// bsam gtan der sems ska cig ma/ (105)ri mo legs 'bar shes rab bo// pha rol phyin pa drug rnams kyis// thub pa'i maṇ+ḍal legs byas pa'o// 'dir ni lus kyi las byas na// kha dog gser ltar 'gyur ba dang*// nang rnams kun las rnam par grol// lha dang mi las ches lhag cing*// zla ba lta bu'i gzi brjid can// nor dang gser ni phun sum tshogs// rgyal po'i rigs dang sangs rgyas pa// mchog gi khyim du skye ba nyid// slar yang re khā byas la/ oṃ badz+ra re khe sarba bud+dha a dhiṣ+ṭhā n+tu swā hā/ chu des maṇ+ḍal bkru/ oṃ waṃ swā hā/ maṇ+ḍal phyis la/ oṃ tsan+d+ra arka bi ma le swā hā/ me tog bkram la/ oṃ badz+ra sa twa sa ma ya sogs yig brgya brjod/ de nas tshom bu nyer gsum pa rim bzhin bkod pa'i dang po dbus su tshom bu gcig bzhag la/ oṃ haṃ su me ru na maḥ shar du/ yaṃ bi de ha dwi pa na maḥ lhor/ ri dzam+bu dwīpa na maḥ nub tu/ laṃ god nī dwī pa na maḥ byang du/ waṃ ku ru dwī pa na maḥ shar gyi g.yas g.yon gnyis su/ yaḥyaḥ.u pa dwī pa na maḥ lha'i g.yas g.yon/ raḥraḥ.u pa dwī pa na maḥ nub kyi g.yas g.yon/ laḥlaḥ.u pa dwā pa na maḥ byang gi g.yas g.yon/ waḥwaḥ.u pa dwī pa na maḥ nub byang/ laḥtu raṅga rat+na ya na maḥ lho nub/ raḥha sti rat+n+ya na maḥ shar lhor/ yaḥg dza r+ny+na ya na maḥ byang shar/ waḥsti rat+nā yan maḥ shar dbus/ yaḥkhaḍ+ga rat+nā ya na maḥ

lho dbus/ raḥm ṇi rat+nā ya na maḥ byang dbus/ waḥni dhi rat+nā ya na maḥ nub dbus/ laḥtsakra rat+nā ya na ma: shar/ oṃ aṃ tsan+d+ra/ nub/ oṃ aṃḥ sū r+ya/ oṃ oṃ/ 'jig rten dang 'jig rten las 'das pa'i zhing 'byor pa tshad med pa kun tu bzang po'i rnam 'phrul las byung ba lta bu mchod pa'i sprin rab 'byams kyi ngo bo nyid na maḥ bdag gzhan lus ngag yid gsum dus gsum dge ba'i tshogs// rin chen kun bzang maṇ+ḍal bzang po'i mchod pa 'di// blo yis blangs nas dpal ldan bla ma'i (106)tshogs la 'bul// thugs rje'i dbang gis bzhes nas byin gyis brlab tu gsol// ces brjod la maṇ+ḍal stegs bu'i dbus su 'jog /rten bskyed pa ni/ maṇ+ḍal 'di nyid dag pa ye shes kyi zhing khams rgya dang tshad yongs su chad pa med pa/ rgyan gyi bkod pa phun sum tshogs pa dang bcas pa/ phyi rol srung ba'i 'khor lo gzhom du med pas yongs su bskor ba'i snying por thar pa chen po'i gzhal med khang rgyu dang bkod pa'i bye brag ngo tshar rmad du byung ba/ dur khrod rol pa'i yo byad dang lha rdzas kyi nyer spyod mtha' klas pas brgyan pa'i dbus su seng ge'i khri chen po pad+ma nyi ma zla ba'i gdan dang bcas pa/ phyi rol phyogs mtshams kun tu so sor 'os pa'i gdan gyi khyad par rnams kyang gsal par gyur/ tshogs zhing spyan 'dren pa ni/ oṃ/ khyab bdag dngos po kun gyi ngo bo nyid// gnas med 'gro 'ong bral ba nam mkha' bzhin// gshegs dang bzhugs pa'i mtshan ma mi mnga' yang*// bde chen dgyes pa dpal ldan he ru ka /grub thob pho mo rnam 'byor dbang phyug tshogs// bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro 'khor dang bcas// bdag gis dad pas deng 'dir gsol 'debs na// dmigs med snying rje'i dbang gis 'dir gsal mdzod// skyes mchog gnyis med ye shes spyan can rnams// chos kyi sku la gshegs 'byon mi mnga' yang*// gzugs sku brtse ba chen po'i rnam 'phrul gyis// dad ldan mchod pa'i zhing du gshegs su gsol// oṃ gu ru badz+ra dha ra sarba yo ge shwa ra de ba ḍā ki nī e h+yi badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ

zhes pas tshogs zhing rnams sprin gtibs pa ltar byon te so so'i gdan la bzhugs par bsam/ dbus kyi khri steng du rtsa ba'i bla ma khyab bdag rdo rje 'chang chen po sku mdog sngon po zhal gcig phyag gnyis rdo rje dang dril bu thugs kar bsnol bas rang snang gi shes rab ma la 'khyud pa/ zhabs rdo rje'i skyil mo krung gis bzhugs pa/ dar dang rin po che'i (107)rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan pa/ mtshan dang dpe byad thams cad yongs su rdzogs shing*/ rang la dgyes pa'i zhal 'dzum bag ldan pa/ 'od dang 'od zer gyi tshogs mtha' yas pa 'phro ba'i sku can/ mtha' bskor phyogs mtshams rnams su grub pa'i slob dpon chen po lū yi pas thog drangs pa'i rnam 'byor dbang phyug brgyad cu/ sring mo ḍā ki bzhi dang bcas pa thams cad kyang lhan cig skyes pa'i bde ba chen po'i ye shes kyi gzi 'od phyogs brgyar 'bar bas bzod par dka' ba'i zil can nyi ma'i snying po lta bu/ srid pa gsum zil gyis gnon pa'i lta stangs kyis rab tu dpa' ba'i nyams can/ gsung gsang sngags rdo rje mi shigs pa'i sgra dbyangs rtag tu sgrogs pa/ thugs gnyis su med pa'i ye shes phyag rgya chen po'i ngang du mnyam par bzhag pa las mi g.yo ba/ lhun gyis grub cing rgyun mi 'chad pa'i phrin las kyi rnam par rol bzang mi shes pa can/ dpa' bo dang ḍā ki rgya mtsho lta bus mchod cing brjod pa dang*/ sa gsum gyi dbang po rnams kyi ri mor byed bzhin pa rnams dgyes pas dgongs te bzhugs pa/ gzhan yang brgyud pa'i bla ma rnams dang*/ yi dam dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs/ sangs rgyas byang sems 'phags pa nyan rang*/ chos skyong srung ma thams cad bzhugs par gyur/ mgon po 'gro ba'i don la byon pa legs// bdag gi mchod yon 'di nyid bzhis nas kyang*// ji srid mchod pa'i bya ba ma rdzogs par// yid 'ong gdan la bde bar bzhugs su gsol// oṃ pra wa ra sa rka ra ar+ghaṃ pra tī ts+tsha swā hā/

ces pas mchod yon phul la/ oṃ pad+ma ā sa na s+t+waṃ/ ces pas gdan la bzhugs par bsam/ phyag 'tshal ba ni/ gang gi drin gyis bde chen nyid// skad cig nyid la 'char ba gang*// bla ma rin chen lta bu'i sku// rdo rje can zhabs pad la 'dud// yon tan kun gyi gter gyur pas// (108)gang gi mtshan tsam dran pas kyang*// bdag blo'i rgud pa zhi mdzad pa// dpal ldan bla ma la phyag 'tshal lo// dri mes yon tan rab rgyas pas// 'gre kun gtsug gi rgyan gyur pa'i// dgos 'dod 'byung ba'i rin po che// bla ma'i zhabs la phyag 'tshal lo// blang dor rtogs pa'i snang ba yis// 'gro kun mi shes mun sel ba// dri med nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor mchog /bla ma'i zhabs la phyag 'tshal lo// bsod nams ye shes bsil zer gyis// phan bde'i tshal rab rgyas mdzad pa// rnam dag zla ba'i dkyil 'khor mchog /bla ma'i zhabs la phyag 'tshal lo// dam chos bdud rtsi'i sman mchog gis// nyon mongs sdug bsngal nad sel ba// thabs mkhas 'gro ba'i sman mchog /bla ma'i zhabs la phyag 'tshal lo// thabs dang shes rab gru chen gyis// srid zhi'i rgya mtsho'i mthar sgrol ba// stobs ldan 'gro ba'i ded dpon mchog /bla ma'i zhabs la phyag 'tshal lo// gnod pa kun las skyob byed pa// phan pa dpag med sgrub mdzad pa'i// byams mgon 'gro ba'i gnyen gcig po// bla ma'i zhabs la phyag 'tshal lo// stong nyid snying rje zung 'jug pas// srid zhi'i mtha' la mi gnas pa'i// mya ngan 'das pa mchog brnyes pa// skyabs mgon khyed la phyag 'tshal 'dud// pha rol phyin pa bcu rdzogs shing*// nyer bzhi rtsa rlung dbang 'dus pas// yan lag bcu gnyis rnam 'gags pas// sa bcu'i mthar son khyed la 'dud// yod min med min gnyis ka min// gnyis ka min pa'ang ma yin pa// rnam dag zag med chos kyi dbyings// spros bral chos sku khyed la 'dud// mtshan dang dpe byad dpal 'bar bas// dag pa'i zhing gi gdul bya la// rtag par theg mchog chos ston pa// bde chen longs sku khyed la 'dud// sna tshogs gdul bya'i bsam pa ltar// sangs rgyas rnam 'phrul dpag (109)med kyis// 'gro kun phan bdes tshim mdzad pa// thabs mkhas sprul sku khyed la 'dud// gzugs sku'i rnams 'phrul sna tshogs kyang*// de yi rang bzhin 'gyur med pa// e ma ho brjod bral zung 'jug dngos// ngo bo nyid sku khyed la 'dud// rnam shes tshogs brgyad gnas gyur zhing*// nyon mongs sgrib pa kun spangs pas// phung po lnga las yongs grol ba'i// ye shes lnga bdag khyed la 'dud// so so rigs bzhi'i thugs mnga' bas// stobs bcu'i bdud kyi dpung bcom nas// mi 'jig bzhi yis chos ston pa// yon tan mnga' bdag khyed la 'dud// spyod pa rtogs pa ye shes dang*// phrin las gzhan dang ma 'dres pa'i// sangs rgyas yon tan bco brgyad can// mtshungs med dam pa khyed la 'dud// rdo rje 'chang chen lū yi lī la pa// mthu stobs dbang phyug dom+bi sha ba ri// sa ra ha pa kaṅka li pa dang*// mī na go rak+ṣa la phyag 'tshal lo// tsau riṅga dang wī ṇa shān+ti pa// tsan+ti tsa ma ri dang khaḍ+ga pa// klu sgrub spyod 'chang dbang po 'phags pa lha// tha ga nā ro pa la phyag 'tshal lo// sh+ya li te tsa tra bha dra pa// dhū khan+dhi dang sbyor bral ga la pa// dhū ti kaṅka na dang kam+ba la// ḍiṅgi ban+dhe pa phyag 'tshal lo// tan+te ku ku ri dang ku dzi pa// dha ma ma hi la dang a tsin+ta// ba bha nā li na ba zhi ba lha// in+d+ra bo dhi rnams la phyag 'tshal lo// me ko tog rtse pa dang kam+bha ri// dza lan+dhar rā hu dharma pa// dho ka me dhi pa na saṅka dza// rdo rje dril bu pa la phyag 'tshal lo// dzo ki tsa li ki pa ko ru ra// lu tsi dza ya nan+ti na gu ṇa// ba tsa ri dang tsa mā ka bhi k+ṣa// dhi le kum+bha ri la phyag 'tshal lo// tsar+pa ṭi pa ma ṇi bha dra dang*// mi khā li ma ka na kha ma la// ka la ka la pa dang skan+dha li// dha hu u dhi li la phyag 'tshal lo// ka pā la pa ka ra ba la dzar// sa ka ra pa sarba bhak+ṣapa// na ga bo dhi dā ra'i ka pa che// su ta li pa rnams la phyag 'tshal lo// (110)pa ha na pa ko ki la pa dang*// a nod+ga pa lak+ṣ+mī ka ra// sa mu dra pa byā li pad bcas// grub chen brgyad bcu rtsa bzhir phyag 'tshal lo// lhag pa'i lha dang grub pas rjes su bzung*// dam pa'i rigs sad chos nyid bden pa gzigs// mi slob lam la zung 'jug sku mchog brnyes// rnal 'byor dbang phyug rnams la phyag 'tshal lo// rtsa brgyud bla ma yi dam lha yi tshogs// sangs rgyas byang sems mkha' 'gro chos skyong la// ma lus zhing rdul grangs snyed rab sprul nas// sgo gsum gus pa chen pos phyag 'tshal lo//

de nas mchod pa phul ba la thog mar chu gnyis dang nyer spyod lnga ni/ dri med rnam dag yi 'ong lha yi rdzas// yan lag brgyad ldan rdo rje ar+ghaṃ'i rgyun// mchod tu dad pa'i yid kyis bdag 'bul na// ci bde bar ni dgyes par bzhes su gsol// oṃ āḥhri pra wa ra sa rka raṃ ar+ghaṃ pra tīts+tsha swā hā/ dri med rnam dag yid 'ong lha yi rdzas// zhabs kyi pad+mo'i rnyogs sel spos kyi chu// mchog tu dad pa'i yid kyis bdag 'bul na// ci bde bar ni dgyes par bzhes su gsol//

sngags gong ltar la/ ar+ghaṃ mal du/ pā d+yaṃ sbyar/ mdog bzang dbyibs legs tshim pa'i dri bsung can// man+da ra dang ut+pal ku muta sogs// dngos 'byor yid kyis sprul pa'i me tog kun// bla ma grub thob dkyil 'khor tshogs la 'bu// oṃ gu ru badz+ra dha ra sarba yo ga shwa ra de ba ḍa ki nī sa pa ri wā ra badz+ra puṣ+pe pra tīts+tsha swā hā/ rgyu bzang mnam na zhim pa'i dri ngad can// a ka ru dang tsan+dan sbrul snying sogs// dngos 'byor yid kyis sprul pa'i bdug spos kun// bla ma grub thob= badz+ra dhū pe= mun sel dngos grub gsal ba'i gzi brjid can// sgron me nyi zla lus kyi 'od la sogs// dngos 'byor yid kyis sprul pa'i snang gsal kun// bla ma grub thob= badz+ra ā lo ke= dri zhim byugs na bde (111)ba'i rig mchog kun// ga bur gla rtsi mnam pa'i dri la sogs// dngos 'byor yid kyis sprul pa'i dri mchog kun// bla ma grub thob= badz+ra gan+dhe= mdog bzang myong na bde ba'i ro bcud ldan// 'bras chen ka ra rgya bstar khu ba sogs// dngos 'byor yid kyis sprul pa'i zhal zas kun// bla ma grub thob= badz+ra ni wi t+ya= don zab thos na snyan pa'i sgra dbyangs can// rnga chen dung dang pheg rdob rgud mang sogs// dngosa'agyor yid kyis sprul pa'i sil snyan kun// bla ma grub thob= badz+ra shap+da zhes sbyar/ de nas mchod pa'i maṇ+ḍal phyi zhing lag len tshul ldan byas la tshom bu so bdun ma sogs rgyas bsdus tshar grangs gang lcogs dang*/ ri mchog gser gyi ri dang rol mtsho brgya ldan 'khor yug bcas// gling rnams lha dang mi yi 'byor pa kun gyis rnam par brgyan// gzugs mdzes yan lag mchog ldan zag med bde ster lha mos spras// sangs rgyas kun gyi rnam dag zhing du yongs su bsngo bar bgyi// rab yangs 'byung bzhi'i dkyil 'khor brtan pa la// bkod legs ri gling 'khor yug rgya mtshos spras// brtan g.yo'i dpal gyis phyur bur gtams pa yi// phun tshogs 'jig rten khams kyis bla ma mchod// snod kyi 'jig rten sa phyogs yid 'ong na// bcud kyi sems can mchod pa gang gnas// bdag pos bzung dang ma bzung de dag kun// blo yis blangs nas bla ma'i dkyil 'khor mchod//

sngags snga ma ltar la/ rat+na maṇ+ḍal pū dza me gha sa mu dra s+pha ra ṇa sa ma ye hūm̐/ dri med bai ḍū'i sa gzhi yangs pa la// gser dngul rtsig pa ba gam drwa ba can// rin chen ka bas bteg cing khyon yangs pa// yid 'ong pho brang gzhal med dam pas mchod// bla bre rgyal mtshan gdugs so steng nas mdzes// dar dbyangs lhab lhub yol bas (112)logs nas brgyan// khri dang gdan sogs 'og nas brjid gyur pa'i// phun tshogs nyer mkho'i gzigs chu kun gyis mchod// thar pa'i rgyal mtshan chos gos ngur smrig dang*// srab 'jam yang ba'i pañtsa li ka dang*// rgyu bzang dri zhim kā shi'i ras la sogs// phun tshogs na bza' kun gyis bla ma mchod// rigs lnga'i dbu rgyan dar gyi cod pan dang*// mu tig do shal nor bu'i ga sha dang*// rin chen phra bkod gser gyi gdu bu sogs// phun tshogs rgyan mchod kun gyis= bsod nams du ma'i dpal las grub pa'i rdzas// 'khor lo nor bu btsun mo blon po dang*// glang po rta mchog dmag mi rin chen te// rgyal srid rin chen kun gyis= nye bar mkho ba'i 'dod rgu 'byung ba'i rdzas// nags tshal ral gri khang bzang mal stan dang*// lha yi gos dang sprul gyi pags pa lham// nye ba'i sna bdun gyis= skye dgu bde zhing dge bar byed pa'i rdzas// rtsa mchog dūrba bi wa gi waṃ zho// me long li khri yungs kar g.yas 'khyil dung*// bkra shis rdzas mchod brgyad kyis= bsod nams brgyad ldan mtshan bzang las grub pa'i// dpal be'u 'khor lo pad+ma rgyal mtshan dang*// gdugs dang bum bzang dung dkar gser nya ste// bkra shis rtags brgyad kun gyis= 'dod 'jo'i ba mo dpag bsam ljon pa'i shing*// ma rmos lo tog yid bzhin nor bu dang*// 'chi med bdud rtsi ro brgya'i zas la sogs// longs spyod phun tshogs kun gyis bla ma mchod// dkon mchog mchod dang sems can don bsgrub phyir// bsod nams longs spyod bcas pa bdag gi lus// skyes mchod khyed kyi bran du legs phul nas// ji ltar bgo ba'i don kun bsgrub bgyi'o//

nang mchod 'dod yon lnga ni/ rab 'byams phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten ji snyed na// kha dog dbyibs kyi gzugs mchod 'os kun// (113)rab mdzes gzugs kyi lha mor blos sprul nas// mgon po sgrib med rdo rje'i spyan la 'bul// sngags gong ltar la/ rū pa kā ma gu ṇa pū dza āḥhūṃ/ rab 'byams= zin dang ma zin sgra mchod 'os kun// rab mdzes sgra yi lha mor blos sprul nas// mgon po sgrib med rdo rje'i snyan la 'bul// shap+da kā ma= lhan skyes sbyar ba'i dri mchog ji snyed kun// rab mdzes dri yi lha bor= mgon po sgrib med rdo rje'i shangs la 'bul// gan+dhe= rab 'byams= bza' bca' btung ba'i mchog mchod 'os kun// rab mdzes ro yi lha mor= mgon po sgrib med rdo rje'i ljags la 'bul// ra sa kā ma= rab 'byams= sems can sems can min pa'i rig mchog kun// rab mdzes reg bya'i lha mor= mgon po sgrib med rdo rje'i sku la 'bul// spar+she kā ma= oṃ āḥhūm̐/ bdud rtsi lnga yi bza' ba ni// dngos grub kun gyi de nyid mchog /sgron ma lnga yi bza' ba ni// sangs rgyas kun gyi dam tshig gtso// nyes bral zhi ba'i btung ba mchog /sbrang rtsi bu ram 'bru dang shing*// bcos pa'i myos byed rnam pa lnga// shes rab rang bzhin dbul bar bgyi// sngags gong ltar la/ pañtsa a mṛ ta= gsang mchod rig ma bcu drug ni/ bde mchog sgyu ma'i longs spyod rdzogs gsal ba// pi waṃ gling bu rnga zlum rdza rnga can// rgod dang sgeg dang glu len bro gar mkhan// me tog bdug pa sna gsal dri mchog ma// gzugs ma ro ma reg ma chos 'byung ma// bcu drug dga' ba'i cha shas yongs rdzogs ma// rdo rje rig ma gda' ba'i rol pa 'dis// he ru ka khyed rdo rje'i yid dges mdzod// rdo rje pad+mar byin brlabs nas// snyoms 'jug 'pho med bde chen thob// rang bzhin snang ba yongs dag pa// zhu bdes khams gsum kun khyab pa// gsang ba'i mchod pas mnyes par bgyi//

sngags mthar/ a nu rak+to ma hā su kha= de kho nyid kyi (114) mchod pa ni/ 'gro ba chu yi zla ba bzhin du lta ba dang*// thos pa brag cha dang ni mtshungs par yang dag 'jug /sems kyang mya ngam smrig rgyu lta bur blta bya zhing*// 'di ltar bza' dang btung bdag ni nam mkha' lta bu ste// dri ni nam mkha' me tog mtshungs par mnam pa dang*// yid ni nyi ma zla ba lta bur khyab pa nyid// yang dag gnas pa de yang ri bo mchog tu mtshungs pa yin// gzhon nu ma yi rmi lam ji bzhin rmi bar bya// tha snyad dag ni sgyu ma mig 'phrul lta bur brjod// 'dir ltar ji bzhin lhan skyes bde 'byung de bzhin te// srid pa'i rang bzhin bral ba bsam gyis mi khyab pa yi thugs// rtag tu 'char ba bde gshegs lam mchog dag gis mchod// de nas bstod pa rgya bod bla ma rnams kyis mdzad pa khungs ldan ji rigs pa dang*/ spyi bstod ni/ rnam dag sku ni skyon bral 'khrul pa med// phun tshogs gsung dbyangs shes bya ma lus khyab// zab dang rgya che'i de nyid mkhyen pa'i thugs// rdo rje gsum dngos bla ma'i tshogs la bstod// nyes pa'i skyon kun rab spangs shing*// legs pa'i yon tan kun ldan pas// phan bde dpal 'byor kun 'byung ba'i// dpal ldan bla ma khyed la bstod// gdul bya smin cing grol ba'i phyir// dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad nyid// 'dren pa'i tshul du rnam 'phrul pa'i/ dpal ldan bla ma khyed la bstod/ khyed sku sha dang rus bral yang*// ye shes gzugs su snang ba'i sku// dad pa'i mig rkyen mchog gyur ba// sku yid dbang phyug khyed la bstod// brjod 'dod rtsol ba mi mnga' yang*// yan lag drug cu'i gsung dbyangs kyis// zab dang rgya che'i don ston pa// gsung gi dbang phyug khyed la bstod// shes dang shes bya'i spros bral yang*// shes bya'i dkyil 'khor gsal ba'i thugs// snying rje'i gzugs spobs du ma'i gter// thugs rje'i dbang phyug khyed la bstod*// yon tan cha tsam 'gro kun gyis// (115)bskal par brjod kyang mi zad pa'i// spyan dang mngon shes rdzu 'phrul sogs// yon tan dbang phyug khyed la bstod// mthong thos dran pas don ldan na// bsten na phrog pa ci smos pa// lhun grub rgyun chad mi mnga' ba'i// phrin las dbang phyug khyed la bstod// bde dang stong pa dbyer med pas// thabs shes zung du 'jug pa'i dngos// sku gsung thugs kyi rdo rje can// 'gro ba'i dpal mgon khyed la bstod// khyed sku phung po'i rigs lnga ste// 'byung ba yum lnga'i lha mo dang*// zung 'jug lhan skyes rdo rje'i sku// 'gro ba'i dpal mgon khyed la bstod// dbang po rnams ni sems dpa' ste// yul drug sems ma'i tshogs rnams dang*// zung 'jug lhan skyes rdo rje'i sku// 'gro ba'i dpal mgon=

yan lag rnams ni khro rgyal te// bya ba rnam bcu'i khro mo dang*/ zung 'jug= 'gro ba'i = khyed sku'i khams rnams dpa' bo ste// rtsa gnas dpa' mo'i tshogs rnams dang*// zung 'jug = 'gro ba'i = rtsa ba'i rlung rnams yab lnga ste// 'byung ba lnga yi yum rnams dang*// zung 'jug lhan skyes rdo rje'i gsung*// 'gro ba'i dpal = khyod thugs ye shes rang bzhin ste// snang yul chos kyi dbyings rnams dang*// zung 'jug lhan skyes rdo rje'i thugs// 'gro ba'i dpal mgon khyed la bstod// dkyus su de tsam gyis 'thus// cung zad spro na/ chos kun dbyings su mngon byang chub// bde stong zung 'jug srid zhi'i dpal// rigs brgya'i khyab bdag 'khor lo'i mgon// rdo rje 'chang la phyag 'tshal bstod// rgyal srid spangs nas gaṅgā'i 'gram// nya yi rgyu ltos 'tsho ba mdzad*// dngos grub mchog brnyes lū yi pa// rnal 'byor dbang phyug zhabs la 'dud// rgyal rigs 'dod yon lnga yis sgeg /dran pa gcig pa'i ting 'dzin gyis// dngos grub mchog brnyes lī la pa// rnal 'byor (116)dbang phyug zhabs la 'dud// phag mo bsgrubs pas dngos byin rlabs// ngo mtshar rdzu 'phrul du ma bstan// dngos grub mchog brnyes bi rū pa// rnal 'byor= dgyes pa rdo rje dngos su grub// stag la chibs nas spyod pa spyad// dngos grub mchog brnyes ḍom+bi pa// rnal 'byor= spyan ras gzigs kyis rjes su bzung*// ye shes sku yis 'gro don mdzad// dngos grub mchog brnyes sha ba ri// rnal 'byor= bram ze'i rigs las gnyis rtog chod// phyag rgya chen po mthar thug rtogs// dngos grub mchog brnyes sa ra ha// rnal 'byor= tha mal chung ma'i rnam rtog nyid// bde stong 'od gsal dbyings su stor// dngos grub mchog brnyes kaṃ ka ri// rnal 'byor= nya ltong 'jig rten mchog thob cing*// rim par sa lam yon tan rdzogs// dngos grub mchog brnyes mī na pa// rnal 'byor=

la nga skyong bzhin gdams pas grol// sems can sa ya gtan bder bkod// dngos grub mchog brnyes go rak+ṣa// rnal 'byor= bsam su med pa'i gdams ngag gis// yan lag bcad pa rang sor chud// dngos grub mchog brnyes tsau riṅga// rnal 'byor= pi waṃ sgra las ting 'dzin grub// gha hu'i grong khyer chos la bkod// dngos grub mchog brnyes wī ṇa pa// rnal 'byor= mkhas shing grub pas thub bstan skyong*// slob ma'i gdams pas bden pa gzigs/sasas /dngos grub mchog brnyes shān+ti pa// rnal 'byor= thag mkhan rgan po gzhon nu'i lus// san+do'i grong khyer mkha' spyod bkod// dngos grub mchog brnyes tan+te pa// rnal 'byor= lham bzos sems sbyong phrug gcig gis// dri ma kun dag gnas lugs rtogs// dngos grub mchog brnyes tsa ma ri// rnal 'byor= thun mong ral gri'i grub pa thob// sgo gsum 'khrul pa'i dri ma sangs// dngos grub mchog brnyes khaḍ+ga ba// rnal 'byor= sangs rgyas gnyis pa'i (117)mdzad pa skyong*// shing rta chen po'i lam srol gtod// dngos grub mchog brnyes 'phags pa klu// rnal 'byor= sum stong 'khor bcas brtul zhugs spyod// bar dor mngon par byang chub pa'i// dngos grub mchog brnyes kah+ṇa pa// rnal 'byor= mngal gyis ma gos brdzus te 'khrungs// nyon mongs dgra bcom chos nyid mthong*// dngos grub mchog brnyes 'phags pa lha// rnal 'byor= brdzun smra'i gnyen por brdzun bsgoms pas// snang srid brdzun gyis chos su rtogs// dngos grub mchog brnyes tha ga pa// rnal 'byor= gnas lnga mthar phyin paṇ+ḍi ta// dka' ba chen po bcu gnyis spyad// dngos grub mchog brnyes na ro pa// rnal 'byor= sgra kun spyang ki'i skad du nub// 'jigs med rang grol nyams rtogs shar// dngos grub mchog brnyes sh+ya li pa// rnal 'byor= bka' bzhi brgyud pas byin gyis brlabs// rdo rje 'chang gis rjes su bzung*// dngos grub mchog brnyes til+li pa// rnal 'byor=

stong nyid snying rje'i rnal 'byor bsgoms// lnga brgya'i 'khor bcas mkha' spyod gshegs// dngos grub mchog brnyes tsa tra pa// rnal 'byor= lta sgom spyod pa'i brda' don rtogs// snang srid 'khrul pa'i gzugs brnyan mthong*// dngos grub mchog brnyes bha dra pa// rnal 'byor= phyag dar khrod kyi tshem drub dang*// lha sngags dbyer med chos skur rtogs// dngos grub mchog brnyes dhū khan+dhi/ /rnal 'byor= stong sgo'i sna rtser gsal snang thob// mtshan 'dzin chos nyid ngang du stor// dngos grub mchog brnyes a dzo gi /rnal 'byor= gzugs mdzes bskyed rdzogs don la sbyangs// shugs 'byung lhug pa'i spyod pa spyad// dngos grub mchog brnyes ka la ba// rnal 'byor= chu dang ting 'dzin lhan cig pa'i// khrus kyis sgrib gnyis rtsad nas dag /dngos grub mchog brnyes dhu pi pa// rnal 'byor= phyag gdub sems zin (118)lnga brgya'i lor// blon 'bangs 'khor bcas mkha' spyod grub// dngos grub mchog brnyes kaṅka na// rnal 'byor= yum gyi gdams pas rang rgyud grol// phra man mang btul lwa ba gsol// dngos grub mchog nyes kam+ba la// rnal 'byor= 'bras rdungs las kyi rtog pa sbyangs// bdun brgya'i 'khor bcas mkha' spyod grub// dngos grub mchog brnyes ḍiṅgi pa// rnal 'byor= tshad med bzhi yi lta sgom spyad// bzhi brgya'i 'khor bcas mkha' spyod gshegs// dngos grub mchog brnyes ban+dhe pa// rnal 'byor= cho los nor rdzas zad pa'i dpes// khams gsum rnam rtog dbyings su zad// dngos grub mchog brnyes tan+te pa// rnal 'byor= mngon shes ldan cing lha yis mchod// ḍā ki khye gu'i gzugs can bsten// dngos grub mchog brnyes ku ku ri// rnal 'byor= lba ba yod med rtog pa yi// mtha' gnyis spangs pas mtha' bral rtogs// dngos grub mchog brnyes ma hi pa// rnal 'byor=

thos pa 'dzin la rab brtson nas// du ma ro gcig rtogs pa skyes// dngos grub mchog brnyes dha ma pa// rnal 'byor= stobs po che yi brgya la nyid// dngos med stobs ldan gdams pas bcom// dngos grub mchog brnyes ma hi pa// rnal 'byor= nor rdzas 'dod pa'i rtog pa kun// rtog med nam mkha'i ngang du nub// dngos grub mchog brnyes sa tsin+ta// rnal 'byor= rtsa rlung thig le'i rnal 'byor las// 'pho med bde chen ro yis myos// dngos grub mchog brnyes ba bha hi// rnal 'byor= pad rtsal 'tsho zhing zhu bde'i lam// mthar phyin 'khrul pa'i dri ma sangs// dngos grub mchog brnyes nī li nā// rnal 'byor= bhu bu ku yi brtul zhugs bskyang*// spyod 'jug gsungs shing mkha' la gshegs// dngos grub mchog brnyes zhi ba lha// rnal 'byor= btsun mo lnga brgya'i 'khor dang bcas// 'dod yon ma (119)spangs chos nyid rgyan// grub brnyes in+d+ra bo dhi che// rnal 'byor= gnyug ma'i don rtogs dur khrod nyul// smyon pa'i spyod pas 'jigs 'jigs lta// dngos grub mchog brnyes me ki pa// rnal 'byor= sems kyi ri bo rang rig pa'i// rtog rtses rgyun chad med pa brkos// dngos grub mchog brnyes ko ṭa li// rnal 'byor= mgar gyi bzo yis rang rgyud kyi// rnam rtog nyon mongs mtha' dag sbyangs// dngos grub mchog brnyes kam+bha ri// rnal 'byor= ye shes mkha' 'gros smin grol rtsal// grub mchog kun gyi 'dren pa mdzad// grub brnyes dza lan+dha ra pa// rnal 'byor= gnyis med rtogs pa'i sgra gcan gyis// gnyis 'dzin zla ba dbyings su zos// dngos grub mchog brnyes rā hu la// rnal 'byor= mkhas pa smra ba gtsor mdzad pa// rgas tshe bsgoms pas ye shes 'char// dngos grub mchog brnyes dharma pa// rnal 'byor= stong pa nyid kyi snod khur nas// bde chen 'bras bu rtag tu slong*// dngos grub mchog brnyes dho ka ri// rnal 'byor=

zhing pa'i las kyis rnam rtog sbyangs// nam mkhar 'phags te 'gro mang sgrol// dngos grub mchog brnyes me dhi ni// rnal 'byor= pad skyes 'phags pa'i gdams pa nos// zhag bdun bsgoms pas 'ching las grol// dngos grub mchog brnyes saṅka dza// rnal 'byor= pho nya'i lam gyis bde chen grub// 'khor lo sdom pa'i sku ru bzhengs// dngos grub mchog brnyes dril bu pa// rnal 'byor= gnas chen nyer bzhir sgrub pa mdzad// bcu gnyis lo ru dri ma dag /dngos grub mchog brnyes dzo ki pa// rnal 'byor= snang srid lus ngag yid gsum sdud// la la ra sa dhū tir chud// dngos grub mchog brnyes tsa lu ki// rnal 'byor= sgra kun 'dab chags sgor sbyangs pas// grags stong dbyer med chos nyid rtogs// dngos grub mchog brnyes go ru ra// (120)rnal 'byor= 'khor ba blo log rim gnyis bsgoms// srid zhi mnyam nyid chen por gzigs// dngos grub mchog brnyes lu tsi ga /rnal 'byor= nyal bzhin snang stong zung 'jug bsgoms// 'khrul pa'i rgya grol mkha' spyod gshegs// dngos grub mchog brnyes na gu ṇa// rnal 'byor= gtor mas 'dab chags kun tshims mdzad// gsang ste nang gi rnal 'byor brtson// grub brnyes dza ya nan+ti pa// rnal 'byor= dbul pos 'phags pa'i sprul pa la// khur ba phul bas rjes su bzung*// dngos grub mchog brnyes tsa pa ri// rnal 'byor= me tog rtog pa lam khyer gyis// chos kun mnyam pa nyid du grol// dngos grub mchog brnyes tsam+pa ka /rnal 'byor= ye shes mkha' 'gror tshem phul bas// snang stong zung 'jug gdams pas grol// dngos grub mchog brnyes bhi k+ṣa ṇa// rnal 'byor= snum tshong 'byor pa'i dpal la brten// mtshan ma rang grol rtogs pa thob// dngos grub mchog brnyes me dhi li// rnal 'byor= rdza ma'i las kyi rtog pa dang*// mi rtog ye shes gnyis med 'dres// dngos grub mchog brnyes kum+bha ri// rnal 'byor=

bcud len grub pas skye bo rnams// don chen po la yud kyi 'god// dngos grub mchog brnyes tsarba ṭi// rnal 'byor= grub thob gdams pas rgyud smin zhing*// rdza ma chags pas rang bzhin grol// grub brnyes ma ṇi bha dra zhes// rnal 'byor dbang mo'i zhabs la 'dud// khyim bdag bu mos gdams pas grol// dbu bcad slar la 'byor bar mdzad// dngos grub mchog brnyes me kha li// rnal 'byor dbang mo'i= nag po spyod pas rjes su bzung*// spros bcad brda' don bla mar phul// grub brnyes ka na kha la zhes// rnal 'byor dbang mo'i= sgra rtog nam mkha'i dbyings su stor// snang grags phyag rgya chen por shar// grub brnyes ka la ka la pa// rnal 'byor= tshom bu phyi dang nang bsres pas// (121)stong nyid snying rje zung 'jug rtogs// dngos grub mchog brnyes kan+ta li// rnal 'byor= kun brtag gzhan dbang rtswa thag nyid// dngos grub ngo bo gnyis med rtogs// dngos grub mchog brnyes dha hu li// rnal 'byor= gnas chen nyer bzhir sman mchog btsal// mkha' la 'phur pa'i rdzu 'phrul thob// dngos grub mchog brnyes u dhi li// rnal 'byor= chung ma'i thod pas phor snod dang*// bu tsha'i rus pas rgyan drug byas// dngos grub mchog brnyes ka pā la// rnal 'byor= rgyal srid dpung gi bkod pa la// brten nas lam gyi mngon rtogs 'byangs// grub brnyes ki ra ba la pa// rnal 'byor= 'phags pas dbang stsal gdams pas grol// 'dod rgu'i char pas rgud pa skyabs// dngos grub mchog brnyes sa ka ra// rnal 'byor= snang srid bza' dang btung bar spyad// nyi zla gnyis kyang 'jigs nas bros// grub brnyes sarba bhak+ṣa pa// rnal 'byor= dpal gyi ri la rtag tu bzhugs// 'gro la grub chen brgyad po stsal// dngos grub mchog brnyes klu'i byang chub// rnal 'byor= bla ma'i rjes bsnyags rgyal srid dor// gzugs 'tshong ma yi khol po mdzad// dngos grub mchog brnyes dā ri ka

/rnal 'byor= dgyes rdor bris sku ting 'dzin thob// lha dang 'byung po bla 'og rjes// dngos grub mchog brnyes su ta li// rnal 'byor= mchil l+h+wam sgrar bcas rgyug pa la// mngon zhen lam khyer gdams pa grol// dgos grub mchog brnyes pa na ha// rnal 'byor= skyed tshal khu byug sgra la brten// kun rtog ye shes chen por shar// dngos grub mchog brnyes ko ki la// rnal 'byor= rang gzugs mdzes pa'i nga rgyal can// tshogs drug rang grol lam du longs// dngos grub mchog brnyes a naṅga// rnal 'byor= rgyal chen rigs 'khrungs nges 'byung blos// smyon pa'i spyod pas lam (122)mchog 'byongs// grub brnyes lak+ṣ+mī ka ra// rnal 'byor dbang mo'i zhabs la 'dud// phyi nang tshad med dga' ba bzhis// 'jig rten chos brgyad 'khrul pa zhig /dngos grub mchog brnyes sa mu dra// rnal 'byor= dngul chu'i bcud len la brten nas// 'khor bcas 'chi med lus su gyur// dngos grub mchog brnyes byā li pa// rnal 'byor dbang phyug zhabs la 'dud// gus pas bstod pa phul ba'i mthus// las dang bag chags dri ma sangs// rnam grol dus mnyam ye shes rgyas// grub mchog khyed dang mtshungs par shog /

ces pas byar bstod/ de nas gsol ba gnas pa ni/ grub chen re re'am spyi bsdus kyi gsol 'debs gzhan nas 'byung ba ji ltar rigs pa 'dir sbyar/ rdo rje 'chang chen lū yi lī pa la// sogs gong gi phyag 'tshal gyi chog mtha'/ mā na go rak+ṣa la gsol ba 'debs// zhes bsgyur ba dang/ gsham gyi sho lo ka gcig po bzhag nas/ byams dang snying rje phyogs med 'byongs pa dang*// don dam lhan cig skyes pa'i ye shes de// grub mchog rnal 'byor rnams kyis rtogs pa ltar// bdag gis mngon sum rtogs par byin gyis rlobs// ces brjod/ bla ma rgyang 'bod rgyas bsdus gang bde skabs 'dir sbyor na'ang chog /de nas bshags pa sogs yan lag lha ma rnams ni/ thog med dus nas nyon mongs dbang gyur pas// sgo gsum sgo nas rang bzhin bcas pa'i sdig /bgyis dang bgyid stsal yid rang bgyis pa kun// gnong 'gyod sdom pa'i sems kyis mthol zhing bshags// khyad par rdo rje theg pa'i lta spyod la// shing brtson dman pas ji bzhin sgrub ma nus// the tshom sel zhugs ma tshor dam las nyams// gsang sngags 'chol par gyur sogs snying nas bshags// skyes mchog sras dang bcas pa'i rnam thar dang*// gzhan yang 'gro kun sgo gsum dge ba'i tshogs// byas dang byed 'gyur da lta mdzad rnams la// rab tu dga' ba'i yid kyis yi rang ngo*// (123)sngags dang 'brel ba'i legs spyad phra mo yang*// rlabs chen dge bas bsod nams char mi nye// des na gsang ba chen po'i phyogs bslan pa'i// rmad byung dge la lhag par rjes yi rang*// 'gro kun phan cing dge bar bgyid pa'i slad// chos kyi rgyal po sras dang bcas rnams kyis// gang la gang 'dul zab dang rgya che ba'i// chos kyi 'khor lo rgyun du bskor du gsol// bzod dka' srid pa'i 'khrul 'khor rgyun ring ba// myur du gcod nas ma gyur lus can rnams// gtan bder 'god byed rdo rje nā da'i dbyangs// phyogs dus ris su ma chad sgrogs par mdzod// chos kyi sku la 'jig pa mi mnga' yang*// gzugs sku zhing gzhan don la mi gshegs par// mgon med snyigs ma'i 'gro la rjes brtse bas// mya ngan ma 'da' yun ring bzhugs par 'tshal// mkha' spyod zhing bzang bsten pa'i skal med pa// 'jig rten 'dir gnas lus can yongs kyi mgon// rdo rje theg pa ston pa'i slob dpon ru// sprul nas thub bstan ji srid rtag bzhugs gsol// 'gro kun bla med byang chub thob don du// skyabs mchog khyed la rtag par skyabs mchi zhing*// thun mong khyad par dam tshig sdom pa rnams// deng nas blangs te tshul bzhin bsgrub par bgyi'o// 'dis mtshon zag bcas zag med dge ba'i mthus// 'gro kun srid pa'i 'ching ba kun las grol// bla ma grub thob tshogs kyis rjes bzung nas// tshe gcig mi slob lam mchog mthar phyin shog

/bdag gis dus gsum dge ba ci spyod pas// nam mkha'i mtha' klas gyur pa'i sems can rnams// bla med rdo rje theg pa'i snod gyur te// kun bzang rdo rje 'dzin pa myur thob shog / de nas tshogs mchod 'bul ba ni/ dam tshig gi rdzas su 'os pa'i bza' bca' btung ba'i rigs 'byor pa bshams/ nang mchod bdud rtsis sbran/ oṃ sum+bha sa bsang*/ oṃ swabhāwa sa sbyang*/ tshogs rdzas rnams mi dmigs par stong pa nyid du gyur/ stong pa'i ngang las tshogs rdzas rnams (124)kyi 'og tu yaṃ las rlung*/ raṃ las me'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du a las ye shes kyi ka pā la yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang du sha lnga bdud rtsi lnga ye shes lnga zhu ba las byung ba'i tshogs rdzas zag pa med pa'i ye shes kyi bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho chen por gyur/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ ha hoḥhrīḥ lan gsum/ na mo thabs dang shes rab gnyis su med pa'i tshogs kyi 'khor lo rgya chen po/ rang bzhin rnam par dag pa skye ba med pa/ mtshan nyid rnam par dag pa ā li kā li/ ngo bo rnam par dag pa sha lnga bdud rtsi lngas rgyas btab pa 'di nyid/ byin rlabs kyi rtsa ba rtsa brgyud bla ma rnams kyi zhal du ga ṇa tsakra pū dza me gha sa mu dra s+pha ra ṇa sa ma ye hūm̐/ de bzhin du sbyar te/ na mo thabs dang shes rab= nas/ rgyas btab pa 'di nyid dngos grub kyi rtsa ba yi dam lha tshogs rnams kyi zhal du/ sogs/ na mo nas/ 'di nyid phrin las kyi rtsa ba mkha' 'gro chos skyong srung ma'i tshogs dang bcas pa rnams kyi= na mo nas/ 'di nyid dam tshig gi rtsa ba mched grogs rdo rje spun grogs rnams kyi zhal du sogs slar yar byin 'bebs ni/ dbyings bde gsal mi rtog pho brang cher// rje rdo rje 'chang chen 'gro ba'i mgon// de rang la snang ba skyabs kyi gtso// pha drin can rtsa ba'i bla ma yang*// khyed rnam 'phrul mkha' la sprin bzhin btibs// 'dir gshegs tshogs kyi mchod pa bzhes// gnas khang 'di la byin phobs la// tshogs gtor 'di la bcud cig chugs// 'dir 'dus rnal 'byor bdag cag la// mchog dang thun mong dngos grub stsol// oṃ ma hā gu ru tsa tu rā shī ti sid+dhi la b+dha dz+nyā na ā be sha ya a a/

yul dbus 'gyur ma ga dha yi char// ma 'gro ba'i don du sku bltams pa'i// rje rnal 'byor dbang phyug grub pa'i tshogs// khyod rnam 'phrul= 'dir gshegs= gnas khang= tshogs gtor= 'dir 'dus= mchog dang= oṃ ma hā= yul rgya gar shar phyogs yul ljongs su// ma 'gro ba'i= sogs gong ltar rigs 'gre/ yul rgya gar lho phyogs yul ljongs su// ma 'gro ba'i don du= sogs/ yul rgya gar nub phyogs yul (125)ljongs su// ma 'gro ba'i sogs/ yul rgya gar byang phyogs yul ljongs su// ma 'gro ba'i sogs/ rigs rgyal rigs bram ze rje'u rigs// 'bangs dmangs rigs phal par sku 'khrungs pa'i// rje rnal 'byor dbang phyug sogs/ yab rnal 'byor dbang po mtha' yas kyi// ma lhan cig spyod pa gsang ba'i yum// sring dga' bzhi'i nyams ster thams cad kyang*// khyed rnam 'phrul sogs/ pho rtogs shing grol pa brgyad cu dang*// mo rtogs shing grol pa'i sring mo bzhi// rje grub thob brgyad cu rtsa bzhi'i tshogs// khyed rnam 'phrul mkha' la sprin bzhin sogs/ stug po'i zhing khams 'jigs med par// dpa' bo dpa' mo 'bum sde'i dbus// dkyil 'khor khyab bdag rigs lnga'i rgyal// bcom ldan he ru ka pa yang// rnam 'phrul= zhes pa nas/ gu ru de wa ḍā ki ni dz+nyā na ā be sha ya a a/ mi g.yo 'og min nyams dga'i zhing*// dag pa bde stong mkha' spyod gnas// rgyal ba dgyes pa'i bde skyed yum// rdo rje phag mo mkha' 'gro'i gtso// rnam 'phrul mkha' la= bdud tshogs kun 'dul phrin las zhing*// dur khrod chen po'i gnas brgyad na// bgegs 'joms 'dod don kun sgrub pa'i// dpal ldan mgon po lcam dral yang*// rnam 'phrul mkha' la= bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro'i tshogs// rigs kyi cod pan ldems se ldem// dar gyi cod pan pu ru ru// rgyan cha mang po khro lo lo// rol mo mang po di ri ri// glu len gar byed khyugs se khyug

/'khor tshogs 'bum sde sha ra ra// sgyu ma'i rang snang rjen ne ne// gtad med rig pa sa la la/ brjod med dbyings su tha la la// bde ba chen por phri li li// byin gyis brlab phyir gshegs su gsol// gnas mchog 'di ru byin phobs la// sgrub mchog bdag la dngos grub stsol// bgegs dang log 'dren bar chad sol// 'khor gsum gnyis (126)med par 'dres// gu ru de wa ḍā ki ni dz+nyā na ā be sha ya a ā: zhes brjod la bar mtshams rnams su ḍā dril sogs rol mos bskul/ de nas las kyi rdo rjes lag g.yon thod pa bdud rtsis gang ba bzung*/ g.yas rtse gsum phyag rgyas steng 'og kha sbyor du bzung ste/ 'dir ni chos rnams bzang por ltos// 'dus pa rnams la the tshom med// bram ze khyi dang gdol pa gsum// rang bzhin gcig tu dgongs te rol// a ho ma hā su khaṃ/ tshogs kyi gtso bo nas brtsams te bskor/ de dag gis/ bde gshegs chos la rin thang med// 'dod chags la sogs dri ma bral// gzung dang 'dzin pa dang bral ba// de bzhin nyid la bdag phyag 'tshal// a ho ma hā su khaṃ/ zhes blangs la/ tshogs phud 'bul ba ni/ zhal zas ro brgya ldan cing yid 'phrog pa// legs sbyar 'di ni bla ma lha tshogs la// dad pas phul bas 'gro ba 'di dag gis// 'byor ldan ting 'dzin zas la spyod par shog /oṃ ma hā gu ru badz+ra dha ra tsa tu rā shī ti sid+dhi la b+dha bud+dha bod+dhi satwa wī ra ḍā ki ni sa pa ri wā re bh+yaḥ na maḥ sarba ta thā ga te bh+yo bi shwa mu khe bh+yaḥsarba thā khaṃ ut+ga te s+pha ra ṇa i maṃ ga ga na khaṃ gṛh+ṇe daṃ ba lin+ta swāhā/ zhes pa'am/ oṃ a kā ro btags pa lan bdun gyi bla ma grub thob 'khor bcas la phul/ oṃ shrī he ru ka badz+ra yo gi ni sa pa ri wā ra a kā ro sogs/ lan gsum gyis yi dam/ oṃ shrī ma hā kā la ya shā sa na sogs nas mā ra ya hūṃ phaṭa kyis mgon po chos skyong tshogs la 'bul/

oṃ āḥhūm̐ ha ho hrīḥ pheṃ badz+ra ā ral+li hoḥ dzaḥhūm̐ bam̐ hoḥ badz+ra ḍā ki nī sa ma ya s+t+waṃ dṛ sh+ya hoḥ oṃ kha kha sogs mkha' 'gro spyi gtor ltar gyis mgron gzhan rnams la phul/ nang mchod thogs la/ oṃ mchod do// dman pa'i yul las rab 'das shing*// rgyal ba kun gyi dam tshig mchog /dngos grub kun gyi gzhir gyur pa// bdud rtsi mchog gis mchod par bgyi// sgrib pa'i dri ma kun sel zhing*// rtog pa kun las nges grol ba// bla na med pa'i byang chub sems// bde ba chen pos mnyes gyur cig / ces pa rnams kyis 'bul/ nang gi sreg blugs (127) kyis tshul gyis tshogs la longs spyad/ lhag ma bsdus la lam sgron btsugs/ bsang sbyang*/ stong pa'i ngang las a las ye shes kyi ka pā la yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang du lhag ma'i gtor ma bzang zhing rgya che ba bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho chen por gyur/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ ha hoḥhrīḥ a kā ro lan gsum/ phyi rol sgo drung na gnas pa'i 'byung po 'chol ba'i tshogs dam tshig gi cho ga blta ba la mi dbang ba rnams la sbyin no// rdo rje theg pa la gsang ba mchog gi rnal 'byor spyod pa'i skal pa dang ldan par gyur cig /oṃ uts+tshi pa li ti bhak+ṣa si swāhā/ zhes pas phyi rol du btang la drag sngags sogs kyis mtshams bcas/ de nas rdo rje'i glu blang ba ni/ kol+la i reṭaṭha a bol+la// ma m+mu ṇi ri kak+ko la// gha ṇa kri pa ta ho badz+dza i// ka ru ṇi ki a a ṇi ro lā// tā hiṃ ba la khādz+dza ī// gā ḍīṃ ma a ṇā bidz+dza a i/ ha le ka liñtsa ra pa ni a i/ dudhu ra badz+dzi a i/ tsa u pa ma kats+tshu ri sih+la// ka pu ra las i a i// ma la in+dha na sā li dza// ta hiṃ bha tu kha i a i// phreṃ kha ṇa khe ṭa ka ran+te// shud+dha a shu d+dha ṇ+ṇa ma na a i// ni raṃ su aṃ ga tsa ḍa pi// ta hiṃ dza pa ra ba sa ṇi a i// ma la a tsa kun+tu ru ba ḍa i// ḍi ṇa ḍi ma ta hi na badz+dza a i//

ces sbyar ba'am/ yang na dkyus ltar thams cad rdzogs pa'i mthar sbyar bas kyang rung*/ gzhan yang rdo rje'i glu ci rigs blang*/ dngos sam yid kyi phyag rgyar sbyor ba'i bde stong la mnyam par bzhag go /de nas 'dod don gsol ba ni/ sras bcas rgyal ba kun 'dus grub pa'i dbang*// mgon po khyed la zhu zhing gsol ba ni// phan bde'i 'byung gnas thub bstan dam pa'i chos// thos bsam sgrub pas rgyas par mdzad du gsol// thar pa'i ded dpon bstan 'dzin bshes gnyen rnams// sku la snyun med phrin las rab rgyas pas// rtag tu sdug bsngal gyur pa'i 'gro ba rnams// thar pa'i bde la 'god par mdzad du gsol// dam chos sgrub la brtson pa thams cad kyis// zab lam bla ma'i mos gus mthar phyin nas// (128)spangs rtogs mthar son bla ma'i sa thob ste// gzhan phan tshad med 'grub par mdzad du gsol// de ma thob kyi gnas skabs thams cad du'ang*// bla ma mchog gis rtag tu rjes 'dzin cing*// lus dang longs spyod dge bas mnyes byas te// brtse bas byin rlabs 'jug par mdzad du gsol// grub mchog rnams kyi sku dang bdag gi lus// dbyer med rdo rje'i sku ru byin gyis rlobs// rnal 'byor dbang phyug ci gsung bsgrub pa dang*// gsung ngag dbyer med gsung gi rdo rjer shog /thugs kyi gsang ba'i mdzod kun 'dzin pa dang*// thugs yid dbyer med 'dres par byin gyis rlobs// bla ma dge ba'i bya ba kun bsgrubs nas// mdzad pa phrin las mtshungs par byin gyis rlobs// de nas lam dbang zhu ba'i thog mar phur tshugs gsol 'debs gang shes byas pas chog mod/ rgya gar ba'i gsung rgyun ni/ grub chen brgyad cu rtsa bzhi la// phyag 'tshal snying nas gsol ba 'debs// bdag gi skyid sdug khyed kyis mkhyen// khyed las skyabs gzhan ma mchis so// zhes tshar gang 'grub brjod cing mos gus drag tu bskyed/

de ltar gsol ba btab pas/ bla ma grub thob rnal 'byor gyi dbang phyug rnams kyi dpral ba nas sku'i byin rlabs kyi rang bzhin g.yon rkyang ma dang rjes su 'brel ba'i kun da byang sems dkar po'i rgyun byung*/ rang gi dpral bar thim/ lus kyi dri ma dag /bum pa'i dbang thob/ sku rdo rje'i byin rlabs zhugs/ mgrin pa nas gsung gi byin rlabs kyi ngo bo g.yas ro ma dang rjes su 'brel ba'i rak+ta byang sems dmar po'i rgyun byung*/ rang gi mgrin par thim/ ngag gi dri ma dag /gsang ba'i dbang thob/ gsung rdo rje'i byin rlabs zhugs/ smin mtshams nas thugs kyi byin rlabs dbu ma dang rjes su 'brel ba'i khu khrag 'dres pa'i byang sems byon/ rang gi smin mtshams su thim/ yid kyi dri ma dag /shes rab ye shes kyi dbang thob/ thugs rdo rje'i byin rlabs zhugs par gyur/ de nas grub chen (129)pho mo rnams kyis mgrin gcig tu ngo sprod kyi gdams pa stsal bar gyur// ye shes 'di ni ches phra zhing*// rdo rje nam mkha'i dkyil lta bu// rdul bral mthar phyin zhi ba nyid// khyod kyi pha ni khyod nyid do// gzhi nas ma bcos ye nas lhun grub la// tha mal rang lugs chen po bzhag pa na// skye 'chi med pa nam mkha'i klong yangs su// 'pho 'gyur med pa chos sku'i lus mthong 'gyur// de ltar rdo rje'i tshig tu rtsal thob nas// bsam med ngang du cung zad glod der bzhag /ma bcos so ma rang shar lhan ne ba// lhun grub 'bad rtsol med pa'i ngang tu btang*// zhes pas gsal btab la cung zad mnyam par bzhag / des sgo gsum 'pho ba'i dri ma dag /dbang bzhi pa thob/ ye shes rdo rje'i byin rlabs rgyud la zhugs par gyur// nongs bshags ni/ bdag ni mi shes bag med dbang gyur pas// ma rig nyes pa'i tshogs rnams gang bgyis pa// brtse ldan khyed kyi spyan sngar bshags par bgyi// thugs rje'i rang bzhin can gyis bzod par gsol//

yig brgya lan gsum brjod/ slar yang mos gus drag tu bskyed la/ skyabs mchog khyed ni 'gro ba'i don rab mdzad// chos kyi sku la 'gyur ba mi mnga' yang*// gzugs sku bdag gi lus la rab bskyod nas// brtse ba chen pos byin gyis rlabs tu gsol// ces gsol btab pas 'khor gyi lha tshogs thams cad bla ma'i dkyil 'khor la thim// grub thob pho mo thams cad gtso bo rdo rje 'chang la thim/ de nyid 'od phung gi rnam par ltem gyi zhu nas ngang la sib kyis thim pas sku gsung thugs kyi byin rlabs ma lus pa spar btab ba bzhin du rgyud la 'phos par gyur/

ces mos la chos nyid kyi rang ngo bskyang*/ smon lam gdab pa ni/ skye zhing skye ba dag ni thams cad du// rigs bzang blos gsal nga rgyal med pa dang*// snying rje che zhing bla ma la gus brtan// rdo rje theg pa'i dam tshig la gnas shog /rdo rje dril bu la sogs rtag tu 'chang*// (130)zab dang rgya che'i chos don rtogs pa dang*// go ku shū kra la sogs rtag bza' zhing*// mthar thug bde chen 'grub pa'i skal ldan shog /bde gshegs spyan lngar gnas lugs mkha' 'gro yis// dam bcas srung zhing dngos grub mchog stsol bar// thugs dam bcas shing rtag srung dngos grub ni// rnam gsum tshe 'di nyid la thob par shog / ces dang*/ dpa' bo gnyis med mchod pas skye ba 'di la ni// sgrib pa zad dang phyag rgya'i dngos grub 'gyur bar shog /skye ba kun du mchog tu bde bar gshegs pa yi// grub pa'i 'jig rten dbus su 'gro ba nyid gyur cig /zhing dang nye ba'i zhing sogs bcu gnyis su// dam tshig brda' dang bde spyod rol pa yis// bu bzhin dgongs nas bdag sgrib dag gyur te// bde ba mchog gi sa la 'god par shog /bla ma'i zhabs la rtag tu 'dud byed cing*// rdo rje dbang mo'i zhabs dran gyur nas kyang*// btsun mo'i shū kra'i tshogs la rtag spyod cing*// gsang ba'i pad+mor rol zhing mchod byed shog /dpal ldan dpa' bo dpa' mo nyi shu bzhi'i// zhal mthong de yi ngo bor bdag gyur te// 'gro ba bde ma dam pas 'phongs rnams kyi// nyer 'tshe rin chen lta bur bdag gyur cig /rnam pa mang po'i bsod nams 'di dag kyang*// bdag gzhan dge ba mchog ni bskyed pa'i gzhi// de nyid gsal byed rmongs pa rab 'joms pa// 'gro la mi 'jigs ster ba'i mnga' bdag shog /rnam par rtog pa kun las 'das pa yis// bde chen 'khor lo zag pa med pa'i dbyings// ā li kā li rtog med snyoms 'jug mar// bsags pa'i dge rnams yongs su bsngo bar bgyi// bdag gi bsod nams 'di yis yang yang skye ba'i rim pa rnams su yang*// yun ring 'gro ba'i don bsgrub don la 'jigs pa med par dga' ba dang*// gtso bo sku yi 'od zer nam mkha' khyab par 'gro bas dbang bskur ba// srid gsum rdo rje rol par lhan cig de yi go 'phang (131)thob par shog

/rnam rtog gti mug grong khyer mtha' dag bsal nas he ru ka gtso mkha' 'gro ma'i// 'khor los yongs bskor rgyal ba bla med ye shes 'byung gnas thar pa dam pa'i grong*// sbyin pa la sogs rnams kyis 'gro ba'i yid la re ba yang dag rdzogs pa'i mchog /'di ni shin tu brtse ba tshe ldan 'phags pa'i dpal 'byor rtag par myong bar shog / ces thun mong ma yin pa'i smon lam rgya cher gdab/ de nas bkra shis ni/ rgyal mtshan rtse mo sogs dang*/ phun sum tshogs pa mnga' ba sogs rgyal ba'i bka' las 'byung ba zhig gis thog drangs te 'brel chags par brjod/ mthar/ nyin mo bde legs sogs dang*/ dpal ldan bla mas deng 'dir stsol// sangs rgyas rnams kyis deng 'dir stsol// de bzhin du 'don pa spos la/ dam chos tshogs kyis/ dge 'dun rnams kyis= mes po yis kyang = dbang po yis kyang = 'jig rten skyong bas= dkar phyogs skyong bas deng 'dir stsol// zhes sogs bya zhing me tog 'thor/ rol mo'i sgra 'jam la snyan par bsgrag go /gsang sngags ston pa rdo rje slob dpon nyid// mchod la bsod nams phung po tshad med pa// rgyud rnams kun las ched du bsngags pa'i don// gsal bar brjod 'dir blo ldan yi rang byos// snying nas gus pas mchod cing gsol btab na// gdon mi za bar byin gyis rlobs 'gyur pas// rdo rje theg la zhugs pa'i skal bzang rnams// chos spyod kun gyi mchog 'dir brtson par rigs// bsod nams 'di yis bdag dang 'gro ba kun// thog med 'khrul pa skad cig nyid la sangs// lhan skyes ye shes nyi ma khong nas shar// grub mchog rnams dang dbyer med nyid gyur cig /ces pa 'di nyid mkhyen bla ma rin po che 'jam dbyangs mkhyen brtse'i dbang pos bka' stsal phebs pa dang*/ rang nyid kyang 'brel 'jog tshogs gsog gi cha rkyen du dmigs te mchod phreng sogs kyi tshig sbyor phal mo che sngon rabs dam pa rnams kyi gsung byin rlabs can dang bsdebs te/
